This is a second-price auction (Vickrey auction). In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid one's true private value, regardless of the bidding behavior of others. Bidding higher than my value could lead to a loss if the second-highest bid exceeds $18. Bidding lower than my value increases the chance of losing a profitable item. Since the values are redrawn and this is the only round, bidding exactly my value maximizes my expected profit.
